To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the protein is a homodimer with a single exposed tryptophan residue, binds to LacNAc, fructose and has a single tryptic fragment with a molecular weight of 10, 000 Da.
M.oleifera lectin binds LacNAc and fructose with high affinity and the tryptophan is exposed on the protein surface and is in electropositive microenvironment.
the protein has two different tryptophan environment and the protein has two conformations, one in the native form and the other at extreme acidic or basic pH.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of hemagglutinating activity, saccharide binding, conformational and dynamic properties of a hemaggulutinin from seeds of Moringo oleifera.
a detailed study of the conformational stability of a hemaglutinin, from Moringa Oleifera, using steady state and fluorescence lifetime measurements.
the characterization of the sugar binding and conformation of a hemaglutinin from M. oleifera.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the protein is stable and has an exposed hydrophobic patch in the native state which gets buried in the protein upon unfolding in presence of denaturants.
Moringa lectin has a single trytophan which is exposed to the solvent and is present in a strong electrospositive environment.
the hemagglutinating lectin from Moringa seeds is a monomer, with a single tryptopahn residue exposed on the surface, which gets buried on binding to saccharides.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
M. oleifera lectin has a single trytophan in the surface and is exposed to the solvent.
the hemagglutination activity is a function of both saccharide binding as well as protein conformation.
the protein is a monomer in aqueous solution, has a single trytophan in the exposed region, and has two different conformers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the protein undergoes a conformational change in presence of sugars.
the hemagglutinating activity is independent of the sugar binding ability.
the hemagglutinating activity of Moringa seed lectin is due to the presence of exposed sugar binding sites and the protein is highly stable.
